title: dendropanax selleanus
intro: Dendropanax selleanus, commonly known as Chinese liverwort, is a plant species native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Chinese liverwort include acting as an immune system modulator, an antioxidant, and an anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. Bioactive constituents of Chinese liverwort include sesquiterpenoids, diterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, such as sesquiterpene lactones, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
